description.value: Once every 1d6+1 rounds, the elemental can surround a creature in a thin layer of magically viscous water. A target that fails the Reflex save (DC 18) becomes entangled and must hold its breath or risk drowning. The target or an adjacent creature can spend a full-round action on its turn scraping off the clinging fluid, allowing a new Reflex save with a +2 bonus; otherwise, the effect lasts for 1d4 minutes. The save DC is Wisdom-based. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

effect: Entangled and must hold breath for [[1d4]] minutes. Target or adjacent ally scrapes fluid as full-round action: new save at +2.
Failed save: give the target Congeal Water: entangled (recipient). Activate on the recipient, not the caster.

save.description: Add +2 to the recipient's Reflex roll. Success removes the fluid.

effect: The target or an adjacent ally spends a full-round action. This is a retry for the original victim, not a new exposure.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

description.value: The elemental's touch puts out non-magical flames of Large size or smaller. The creature can dispel magical fire it touches as dispel (caster level equals elemental's HD).

effect: Touch extinguishes nonmagical Large or smaller fires; dispel magical fire at CL 13: [[1d20+@attributes.hd.total]].

description.value: A water elemental can create a whirlpool as a standard action, at will. This ability functions identically to the whirlwind special attack, but can only form underwater and cannot leave the water.

save.description: Negates entry damage. A separate Reflex save avoids capture.

effect: Only underwater. 10-60 ft high. First save avoids damage, second avoids capture; trapped creatures take slam damage on subsequent turns.
Only underwater. 10-60 ft high. First save avoids damage, second avoids capture; trapped creatures take slam damage on subsequent turns.

description.value: A water elemental gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls if both it and its opponent are touching water. If the opponent or the elemental is touching the ground, the element takes a -4 penalty on attack and damage rolls. These modifiers apply to bull rush and overrun maneuvers, whether the elemental is initiating or resisting these kinds of attacks.

effect: A water elemental gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls if both it and its opponent are touching water. If the opponent or the elemental is touching the ground, the element takes a -4 penalty on attack and damage rolls. These modifiers apply to bull rush and overrun maneuvers, whether the elemental is initiating or resisting these kinds of attacks.

description.value: Only in this terrain; also when initiating/resisting bull rush/overrun.

Give this buff to the affected recipient after a failed save. Activate for 10 * (1d4) rounds.

Once every 1d6+1 rounds, the elemental can surround a creature in a thin layer of magically viscous water. A target that fails the Reflex save (DC 18) becomes entangled and must hold its breath or risk drowning. The target or an adjacent creature can spend a full-round action on its turn scraping off the clinging fluid, allowing a new Reflex save with a +2 bonus; otherwise, the effect lasts for 1d4 minutes. The save DC is Wisdom-based. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

effect: Once per subsequent round while captured. Uses the granting elemental's slam bonus, not the victim's Strength.

description.value: Underwater only; the elemental carries creatures caught inside. Roll slam damage on later turns; a qualifying escape check frees the victim.
